info.description: Jira Cloud platform REST API documentation
info.title: The Jira Cloud platform REST API

get.description: Returns the details for an issue.

parameters.description: The ID or key of the issue.
parameters.name: issueIdOrKey

parameters.description: A list of fields to return for the issue.
parameters.name: fields

parameters.description: Whether fields in `fields` are referenced by keys rather than IDs.
parameters.name: fieldsByKeys

parameters.description: Use [expand](#expansion) to include additional information about the issues in the response.
parameters.name: expand

parameters.description: A list of issue properties to return for the issue.
parameters.name: properties

parameters.description: Whether the project in which the issue is created is added to the user's **Recently viewed** project list, as shown under **Projects** in Jira.
parameters.name: updateHistory

parameters.description: Whether to fail the request quickly in case of an error while loading fields for an issue.
parameters.name: failFast

200.description: Returned if the request is successful.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

404.description: Returned if the issue is not found or the user does not have permission to view it.

parameters.description: The ID or key of the issue.
parameters.name: issueIdOrKey

parameters.description: Whether a notification email about the issue update is sent to all watchers.
parameters.name: notifyUsers

parameters.description: Whether screen security is overridden to enable hidden fields to be edited.
parameters.name: overrideScreenSecurity

parameters.description: Whether screen security is overridden to enable uneditable fields to be edited.
parameters.name: overrideEditableFlag

parameters.description: Whether the response should contain the issue with fields edited in this request.
parameters.name: returnIssue

parameters.description: The Get issue API expand parameter to use in the response if the `returnIssue` parameter is `true`.
parameters.name: expand

200.description: Returned if the request is successful and the `returnIssue` parameter is `true`

204.description: Returned if the request is successful.

400.description:
Returned if:

 *  the request body is missing.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

403.description: Returned if the user uses `overrideScreenSecurity` or `overrideEditableFlag` but doesn't have the necessary permission.

404.description: Returned if the issue is not found or the user does not have permission to view it.

409.description: Returned if the issue could not be updated due to a conflicting update.

422.description: Returned if a configuration problem prevents the issue being updated.

post.description: Creates an issue or, where the option to create subtasks is enabled in Jira, a subtask.

parameters.description: Whether the project in which the issue is created is added to the user's **Recently viewed** project list, as shown under **Projects** in Jira.
parameters.name: updateHistory

201.description: Returned if the request is successful.

400.description:
Returned if the request:

 *  is missing required fields.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

403.description: Returned if the user does not have the necessary permission.

422.description: Returned if a configuration problem prevents the creation of the issue.

get.description: Returns details for the current user.

parameters.description: Use [expand](#expansion) to include additional information about user in the response.
parameters.name: expand

200.description: Returned if the request is successful.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

201.description: Returned if the request is successful.

400.description: Returned if the request is invalid.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

404.description:
Returned if:

 *  the project is not found.

post.description: Adds a comment to an issue.

parameters.description: The ID or key of the issue.
parameters.name: issueIdOrKey

parameters.description: Use [expand](#expansion) to include additional information about comments in the response.
parameters.name: expand

201.description: Returned if the request is successful.

400.description: Returned if the request is invalid.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect.

404.description: Returned if the issue is not found or the user does not have permission to view it.

413.description:
Returned if the per-issue limit has been breached for one of the following fields:

 *  comments
 *  attachments

get.description: Returns either all transitions or a transition that can be performed by the user on an issue, based on the issue's status.

parameters.description: The ID or key of the issue.
parameters.name: issueIdOrKey

parameters.description: Use [expand](#expansion) to include additional information about transitions in the response.
parameters.name: expand

parameters.description: The ID of the transition.
parameters.name: transitionId

parameters.description: Whether transitions with the condition *Hide From User Condition* are included in the response.
parameters.name: skipRemoteOnlyCondition

parameters.description: Whether details of transitions that fail a condition are included in the response
parameters.name: includeUnavailableTransitions

parameters.description: Whether the transitions are sorted by ops-bar sequence value first then category order (Todo, In Progress, Done) or only by ops-bar sequence value.
parameters.name: sortByOpsBarAndStatus

200.description: Returned if the request is successful.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

404.description: Returned if the issue is not found or the user does not have permission to view it.

post.description: Performs an issue transition and, if the transition has a screen, updates the fields from the transition screen.

parameters.description: The ID or key of the issue.
parameters.name: issueIdOrKey

204.description: Returned if the request is successful.

400.description:
Returned if:

 *  no transition is specified.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

404.description: Returned if the issue is not found or the user does not have permission to view it.

409.description: Returned if the issue could not be updated due to a conflicting update.

413.description:
Returned if a per-issue limit has been breached for one of the following fields:

 *  comments
 *  worklogs
 *  attachments
 *  issue links
 *  remote issue links

422.description: Returned if a configuration problem prevents the creation of the issue.

scopes.delete:project:jira: Delete projects and their details, such as issue types, project lead, and avatars.
scopes.manage:jira-configuration: Configure Jira settings that require the Jira administrators permission, for example, create projects and custom fields, view workflows, manage issue link types.
scopes.manage:jira-project: Create and edit project settings and create new project-level objects, for example, versions, components.
scopes.manage:jira-webhook: Manage Jira webhooks. Enables an OAuth app to register and unregister dynamic webhooks in Jira. It also provides for fetching of registered webhooks.
scopes.read:bulk-job:jira: View bulk jobs and their results.
scopes.read:email-address:jira: View email addresses of all users regardless of the user's profile visibility settings.
scopes.read:jira-user: View user information in Jira that you have access to, including usernames, email addresses, and avatars.
scopes.read:jira-work: Read project and issue data. Search for issues and objects associated with issues (such as attachments and worklogs).
scopes.write:avatar:jira: Create and update system and custom avatars.
scopes.write:bulk-job:jira: Create and manage bulk jobs, including uploads, retries, and cancellation.
scopes.write:comment.property:jira: Create and update issue comment properties.
scopes.write:field-configuration-scheme:jira: Create and update field configuration schemes.
scopes.write:field.default-value:jira: Create and update field default values.
scopes.write:filter.default-share-scope:jira: Create and update filter default share scopes.
scopes.write:issue-link-type:jira: Create and update issue link types.
scopes.write:issue-type-scheme:jira: Create and update issue type schemes.
scopes.write:issue-type-screen-scheme:jira: Create and update issue type screen schemes.
scopes.write:issue-type.property:jira: Create and update issue type properties.
scopes.write:issue-worklog.property:jira: Create and update issue worklog properties.
scopes.write:issue.remote-link:jira: Create and update issue remote links.
scopes.write:issue.time-tracking:jira: Create and update issue time trackings.
scopes.write:jira-work: Create and edit issues in Jira, post comments, create worklogs, and delete issues.
